column1: # The team `ai-core team-open` opens for a project: one row per kind of session.
# role is coordinator (one row, count 1) or worker. model and effort are what `claude --model` and
# `--effort` take; a model below Sonnet is refused. A session is named
# <first three letters of the project folder>-<model>-<index>, the index counting per model in the
# order of the rows. A project harness overrides this file with a team.tsv of its own.
